# DOI Foundation
> The DOI Foundation governs and explains the Digital Object Identifier system, its community, standards, and operational resources.

The site provides authoritative information about the DOI system, the DOI Foundation, Registration Agencies, governance, and the DOI Handbook. It also links to operational status information and the underlying ISO standard.

## Foundation
- [About Us](https://www.doi.org/the-foundation/about-us/): Overview of the DOI Foundation’s role, mission, and organizational purpose.
- [Board & Governance](https://www.doi.org/the-foundation/board-and-governance/): Governance structure, board information, and organizational oversight details.
- [Sustainability](https://www.doi.org/the-foundation/sustainability/): Information on the DOI Foundation’s sustainability and long-term stewardship approach.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.doi.org/privacy-policy/): Privacy practices governing use of the DOI Foundation website.

## DOI System
- [What is a DOI?](https://www.doi.org/the-identifier/what-is-a-doi/): Introduction to the Digital Object Identifier and how it works.
- [Resources](https://www.doi.org/the-identifier/resources/): Central hub for DOI-related reference materials and supporting information.
- [DOI Handbook](https://www.doi.org/the-identifier/resources/handbook/): Authoritative handbook describing DOI syntax, administration, and system policies.
- [The DOI Handbook](https://www.doi.org/the-identifier/resources/handbook): Canonical handbook link without trailing slash, as referenced in site footer.

## Community
- [What are Registration Agencies?](https://www.doi.org/the-community/what-are-registration-agencies/): Explains the role and responsibilities of DOI Registration Agencies.
- [Existing Registration Agencies](https://www.doi.org/the-community/existing-registration-agencies/): Directory of current DOI Registration Agencies and their domains of service.
- [Who Are The Members and Users?](https://www.doi.org/the-community/who-are-the-members-and-users/): Overview of DOI Foundation members, users, and stakeholder communities.

## Standards and Policies
- [ISO 26324](https://www.iso.org/standard/81599.html): ISO standard defining the Digital Object Identifier system.
- [Trademarks Policy (PDF)](https://www.doi.org/resources/130718-trademark-policy.pdf): DOI trademark usage policy in downloadable PDF form.
- [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/): License governing reuse terms for site content where indicated.

## Operations
- [DOI Proxy Resolver](https://doi.org/): Main DOI resolution service for resolving DOI names to current resources.
- [Status Page](https://doi.statuspage.io/): Operational status, incidents, and availability updates for DOI services.

## Contact
- [Email the DOI Foundation](mailto:info@doi.org): Direct contact address for general DOI Foundation inquiries.
